# skyhub_attached_devices (Data Source)

Devices currently known to the hub (Attached Devices page).

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "skyhub_attached_devices" "all" {}

output "hostnames" {
  value = [for d in data.skyhub_attached_devices.all.devices : d.hostname]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `devices` (Attributes List) One entry per device. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--devices))
- `id` (String) Always `attached_devices`.

<a id="nestedatt--devices"></a>
### Nested Schema for `devices`

Read-Only:

- `dhcp_name` (String) Name from the DHCP lease, if any.
- `hostname` (String) Hostname, or `UNKNOWN`.
- `ipv4` (String) IPv4 address.
- `ipv6` (String) IPv6 address, if any.
- `mac` (String) MAC address.
